name: autologger
description: Claude Code plugins for AutoLogger: connect agents to your sessions, and build AutoLogger itself.

plugins.name: autologger
plugins.description: For producers and operators: connect Claude to your AutoLogger server over MCP, import YouTube videos and playlists, clean up transcripts, generate topics, log moments, build dashboards, update the show wiki, search sessions and write session briefs.

plugins.name: autologger-ask
plugins.description: Ask questions about a show and get timecode ranges per session, saved as cited knowledge-base pages in the show wiki, plus server-built video compilations of YouTube-sourced ranges. Needs the autologger plugin.

plugins.name: autologger-dev
plugins.description: For AutoLogger contributors: skills for adding ops, schema changes, web and Companion work, running the dev stack and checking the MCP surface; an architecture reviewer, a UI designer, a React expert and guard rails. Brings in the impeccable design skill, four React skills and the shadcn/ui MCP server.

plugins.name: autologger-contribute
plugins.description: How to contribute to AutoLogger: a guided first tour, the idea-to-PR workflow, curated starter tasks, a pre-PR check and how to improve these plugins.

plugins.name: react-best-practices
plugins.description: Vercel Engineering's React performance rules (waterfalls, bundle size, re-renders, rendering), prioritised by impact. Packages one skill from vercel-labs/agent-skills (MIT), pinned to a commit.

plugins.name: composition-patterns
plugins.description: Vercel Engineering's React composition patterns: compound components, context providers, avoiding boolean-prop sprawl, React 19 APIs. Packages one skill from vercel-labs/agent-skills (MIT), pinned to a commit.

plugins.name: react-view-transitions
plugins.description: Vercel Engineering's guide to React's View Transition API: route, shared-element, enter/exit and list animations. Packages one skill from vercel-labs/agent-skills (MIT), pinned to a commit.

plugins.name: react-expert
plugins.description: Jeff Allan's React 18/19 specialist skill: components, hooks, state management, Suspense, forms and performance. Packages one skill from jeffallan/claude-skills (MIT), pinned to a commit.
